# HausPower

> HausPower (formerly SmartHaus) is an ECRA/ESA Licensed Electrical Contractor in Ontario, Canada (ECRA #7018055), led by licensed master electrician Matt Allen. It provides electrical and smart home work for luxury residences, custom builds and renovations in Kitchener-Waterloo, Toronto and the GTA, and Muskoka.

- Phone: (519) 635-2078
- Email: hello@hauspower.ca
- Base: Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/smarthaus.ca/

- [Safety & Standards](https://hauspower.ca/safety-standards): ECRA/ESA licensing, the ESA notification and inspection process, eight site safety protocols

- [Request a Quote](https://hauspower.ca/request-a-quote): quote form, phone and email

## Services

- Custom home and new construction wiring
- Renovation upgrades
- Smart home integration and home automation
- Lighting control, interior and landscape
- Panel and service upgrades
- Generator installations
- Security systems
- Collaboration with architects, interior designers and builders
- Boutique commercial projects
